$comment: The names the 2004 Latin prints for one place, joined by seu or vel ('Oświęcim seu Auschwitz'): {Wikidata QID of the place in data/gazetteer.json: [its printed names as nominatives, in printed order]}. martyrology-frontend's index of places files each name that is not the place's heading as a cross-reference to it ('Oświęcim → see Auschwitz'). Only printed names count, not Wikidata aliases. Checked by scripts/build_gazetteer.py check. See CatholicOS/crmedr#86.
